name: BentoShuffleGallery
job: Show photos in an uneven tile layout where tiles trade sizes in turn so each photo gets a moment as the feature
visitor_action: hover or tap a tile to make it the feature; otherwise the gallery rotates the feature by itself; arrow keys choose the feature
motion: feature trade: outgoing tile lifts, winds up and sweeps on a bowed spring arc (tilt, deeper shadow) into the slot of the photo that grows into the 2x2 feature from the opposite bow; neighbours ripple away in its wake (reduced-motion: no auto shuffle, instant swap on tap)
art_direction: Sorbet bento: matte rounded tiles straight on the host page (no panel), peach and pistachio accents, one big bone caption card on the feature, Bricolage Grotesque ink text
